regions.note: #notificationCenter: three stacked notifications, newest on top, bars at 100 / 62.5 / 15 %. max_pct 5.5: the layout matches Chrome's to the sub-pixel (rects probed in the capture); what is left is rasterisation: the titles' synthetic bold (font-weight 600, GameFont has no bold face) is anchored bottom-left by FT_Outline_EmboldenXY where Chrome centres it (~3 %: centring it in text.c drops the title rows to 0.1 %), and the 1.74 px expiration bars at fractional y under the in-game 0.579 scale, which Chrome antialiases over three rows (~1.5 %)
